test_title: PYST 8: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert into active voice:

The artifact may be reinterpreted by historians after new evidence emerges.

options.text: Historians may reinterpret the artifact after new evidence emerges.
New evidence may reinterpret the artifact after historians emerge.
Historians may be reinterpreting the artifact after new evidence emerges.
The artifact may reinterpret historians after new evidence emerges.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• To convert a passive sentence to active voice, the performer of the action (the agent) becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• In the passive sentence: *"The artifact may be reinterpreted by historians..."*, the subject receiving the action is **the artifact**.
 
• The agent performing the action is **historians**, which becomes the subject in the active voice.
 
• The passive modal verb phrase **"may be reinterpreted"** changes to the active form **"may reinterpret"**.
 
• The phrase **"after new evidence emerges"** remains unchanged as it is an adverbial clause.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Historians may reinterpret the artifact after new evidence emerges."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2:** Incorrect – The subject changes illogically; "new evidence" cannot reinterpret anything.
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect – Verb form is not a correct active transformation of the given passive modal structure.
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect – Meaning changes completely; the artifact cannot reinterpret historians.
